routes.label: registration at 15 at school: online, then biometrics at school; ready a month after
registration at 15 at the ICA Services Centre: online, then biometrics there; ready the next working day
re-registration at 30 and at 55: online, processed within 7 working days

note: For Singapore citizens; a permanent resident pays S$50 (not modelled here). The card has no term in years: it must be registered at 15 (before the 16th birthday) and re-registered at 30 and again at 55, so its validity is left null and the player is told. Registration's time is the ICA's, by where the biometrics are enrolled: at school the card is ready a month after, at the ICA Services Centre the next working day; re-registration is processed within seven working days. Until 2026-11-03 the file held one registration route, ready from the next working day wherever the biometrics were enrolled, as the ICA's page said when read on 28 October 2026; its page of 2 November 2026, at a new address, gives registrations at school a month, so the route was split in two.

sources.title: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, Identity Card Registration for 15-Year-Olds (last updated 2 November 2026)
sources.said: You are legally required to register for your first IC if you are an SC or PR upon reaching 15 years old, and before your 16th birthday. ... S$10 for SCs S$50 for PRs ... For Registrations at Schools Your IC will be processed and ready 1 month after your biometrics enrolment. For Registrations at ICA Services Centre Your IC will be processed and ready the next working day after you complete your biometrics enrolment.

sources.title: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, Identity Card Re-Registration for 30/55-Year-Olds (last updated 27 October 2026)
sources.said: You must re-register your IC if you are a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident at: 30 years old (before your 31st birthday) 55 years old (before your 56th birthday) ... S$10 for SCs ... We will process your application within 7 working days.
